# Merriam-Webster
> America's most trusted dictionary, offering definitions, thesaurus entries, usage guidance, word games, and vocabulary resources.

Merriam-Webster provides continuously updated English dictionary and thesaurus content alongside grammar guidance, word history, pronunciation help, rhymes, wordplay articles, and educational tools. The site also includes premium unabridged access, newsletters, and interactive language games.

## Core Reference
- [Dictionary](https://www.merriam-webster.com): Main dictionary search and word entry hub for definitions, pronunciations, examples, and etymologies.
- [Thesaurus](https://www.merriam-webster.com/thesaurus): Synonyms, antonyms, and related words for common and advanced vocabulary.
- [Slang](https://www.merriam-webster.com/slang): Contemporary slang definitions and explanations for informal words and phrases.
- [Rhymes](https://www.merriam-webster.com/rhymes): Rhyme finder for poetry, songwriting, and wordplay.
- [Word Finder](https://www.merriam-webster.com/wordfinder): Tool for finding words by letters, patterns, and game constraints.
- [Medical Dictionary](https://www.merriam-webster.com/medical): Medical terms and healthcare vocabulary definitions.
- [Legal Dictionary](https://www.merriam-webster.com/legal): Legal terminology and law-related definitions.
- [Spanish-English Dictionary](https://www.merriam-webster.com/spanish-english): Bilingual dictionary for Spanish-English word lookup and translation support.

## Editorial Features
- [Word of the Day](https://www.merriam-webster.com/word-of-the-day): Daily featured word with definition, examples, and learning context.
- [Grammar](https://www.merriam-webster.com/grammar): Articles on grammar, usage, punctuation, and common language questions.
- [Wordplay](https://www.merriam-webster.com/wordplay): Editorial stories about language, etymology, quizzes, and lexical trends.
- [Time Traveler](https://www.merriam-webster.com/time-traveler): Browse words by the year they entered English.
- [Words at Play](https://www.merriam-webster.com/wordplay): Language-focused features, explainers, and topical word articles.
- [New Words](https://www.merriam-webster.com/wordplay/new-words-in-the-dictionary): Coverage of newly added dictionary entries and meanings.

## Vocabulary and Learning
- [Vocabulary](https://www.merriam-webster.com/vocabulary): Vocabulary-building articles, quizzes, and word lists for learners.
- [Quizzes](https://www.merriam-webster.com/quizzes): Interactive quizzes covering vocabulary, spelling, and usage.
- [Learner's Dictionary](https://www.merriam-webster.com/learners-dictionary): Simplified definitions and usage help for English learners.
- [Word Lists](https://www.merriam-webster.com/word-lists): Curated lists of words by topic, level, and purpose.
- [Synonym Chooser](https://www.merriam-webster.com/thesaurus): Thesaurus-based help for selecting precise alternatives and related terms.

## Games and Interactive Tools
- [Games](https://www.merriam-webster.com/games): Hub for word games, puzzles, and vocabulary challenges.
- [Quordle](https://www.merriam-webster.com/games/quordle): Daily and practice word puzzle game with four simultaneous boards.
- [Blossom](https://www.merriam-webster.com/games/blossom-word-game): Word-building game focused on creating words from letter sets.
- [Octordle](https://www.merriam-webster.com/games/octordle): Multi-board word puzzle game for advanced players.
- [Missing Letter](https://www.merriam-webster.com/games/missing-letter): Vocabulary game based on completing words from clues.
- [Spell It](https://www.merriam-webster.com/games/spell-it): Audio-based spelling challenge using dictionary words.
- [Merriam-Webster's Biggest Vocabulary Challenge](https://www.merriam-webster.com/games/vocabulary-quiz): Quiz game testing advanced vocabulary knowledge.

## Usage Help and Language Guidance
- [Usage Notes](https://www.merriam-webster.com/grammar): Guidance on disputed usage, grammar rules, and style questions.
- [Commonly Confused Words](https://www.merriam-webster.com/grammar): Explanations distinguishing similar-looking or similar-sounding words.
- [Pronunciation Guide](https://www.merriam-webster.com/help/pronunciation): Help understanding Merriam-Webster pronunciation symbols and audio.
- [How to Use the Dictionary](https://www.merriam-webster.com/help): Help pages for dictionary features, symbols, and entry structure.
- [Word History](https://www.merriam-webster.com): Etymology information embedded in dictionary entries and editorial features.

## Newsletters and Subscriptions
- [Newsletters](https://www.merriam-webster.com/newsletters): Email newsletter signup for word, grammar, and language content.
- [Word of the Day Newsletter](https://www.merriam-webster.com/word-of-the-day): Daily email-oriented word feature with definitions and examples.
- [Merriam-Webster Unabridged](https://unabridged.merriam-webster.com): Premium unabridged dictionary with expanded entries and advanced reference content.
- [Join MWU](https://unabridged.merriam-webster.com/check-redirect-premium?utm_source=mw&utm_medium=global-nav-join&utm_campaign=evergreen): Subscription entry point for Merriam-Webster Unabridged access.

## Specialized Dictionaries
- [Collegiate Dictionary](https://www.merriam-webster.com): General-purpose collegiate dictionary content on the main site.
- [Intermediate Dictionary](https://www.merriam-webster.com): Age-appropriate dictionary content and definitions for developing readers.
- [Elementary Dictionary](https://www.merriam-webster.com): Children's dictionary-oriented content and educational word resources.
- [SCRABBLE Dictionary](https://www.merriam-webster.com/wordfinder): Word lookup support useful for SCRABBLE and other word games.
- [Britannica English](https://www.merriam-webster.com/learners-dictionary): English learner support integrated with learner-focused definitions.

## Help and Site Tools
- [Help](https://www.merriam-webster.com/help): Support pages for using the site, symbols, and reference tools.
- [Chatbot](https://www.merriam-webster.com/chatbot): Conversational tool for exploring Merriam-Webster language content.
- [Browse the Dictionary](https://www.merriam-webster.com/browse/dictionary/a): Alphabetical browsing entry point for dictionary terms.
- [Browse the Thesaurus](https://www.merriam-webster.com/browse/thesaurus/a): Alphabetical browsing entry point for thesaurus entries.
- [Browse Medical Terms](https://www.merriam-webster.com/browse/medical/a): Alphabetical browsing for medical dictionary entries.
- [Browse Legal Terms](https://www.merriam-webster.com/browse/legal/a): Alphabetical browsing for legal dictionary entries.
